_readme: Every fact on the site links to one of these. Verified 2026-10-08. If a link dies, fix it here and rebuild.

angi.name: Angi — How Much Does It Cost to Stain a Deck? (2026 data)
facts: Normal range $550–$1,250; about $850 on average
$2 to $4 per square foot
Restain every two to three years

bobvila.name: Bob Vila — Cost to Stain a Deck
facts: National average $775 (range $540–$1,250)
Oil-based every 3–5 yrs; water-based 2–3; solid 4–5

usdaSouth.name: USDA Forest Products Lab — Exterior Wood in the South (FPL-GTR-69), Table 7 and “Decks and Porches”
facts: Semitransparent stain on decking: 2–3 yrs on new smooth wood, 3–6 yrs on weathered rough wood
Paint and solid-color stains are not appropriate for fully exposed decks
Allow 1 or 2 days drying time

usdaFinishes.name: USDA Forest Products Lab — Finishes for Wood Decks (FinishLine, rev. 2013)
facts: Penetrating finishes, not film-forming finishes, should be used on wood decks
Film-forming finishes … prone to trap moisture and fail by peeling
Power washing can remove wood from the surface
Allow at least 2 warm, windy days to dry
Water-repellent preservative lasts about 1 year on exposed deck surfaces

usdaFinishing.name: USDA Forest Products Lab — Finishing Wood Exteriors (FPL-GTR-106)
facts: Opaque stains should not be used on decks and fences

consumerReports.name: KOMO News — Top-rated deck stains from Consumer Reports (2021)
facts: “Solid color staining always fares best in our testing”
Clearer stains may need reapplying every one to three years; solid color could buy seven to 10 years

fineHomebuilding.name: Fine Homebuilding — Deck Stain Versus Sealer
facts: Most water-based stains last longer than oil-based (2–3 yrs) but often must be removed entirely to refinish
Oil-based refinishing every 1–2 years is less involved: touch up what needs it
Oil-based has higher VOC content

homeDepot.name: Home Depot — How to Stain Pressure-Treated Wood
facts: New pressure-treated lumber may take several weeks to dry
Sprinkle test: absorbs within 10 minutes = ready; beads = wait
KDAT lumber can be stained immediately
Dry 24 hours after cleaning

nadra.name: NADRA — Check Your Deck during Deck Safety Month
facts: Homeowners should check their deck on a yearly basis

nadraChecklist.name: NADRA — Deck safety tips for homeowners (10-point checklist)

tnHomeImprovement.name: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors — Home Improvement License
facts: Required for residential projects $3,000–$24,999 in adopting counties: Bradley, Davidson, Hamilton, Haywood, Knox, Marion, Robertson, Rutherford, Shelby

tnContractor.name: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors — Contractor License
facts: Contractor's license required for projects of $25,000 or more

facts: Annual 55.00 in
Driest: Oct 3.59, Aug 3.67, May 3.94
Sep and Oct have the fewest rain days (7.9 each)
